policy: Use category-level comparisons unless a named competitor claim has been freshly researched, sourced and approved.

categories.gapClearTillAddresses: Does not itself subtract every entered payment still due before payday.
categories.fairnessRule: Do not imply banking apps conceal information or are inaccurate.

categories.alternative: Remembering bills and subtracting them mentally
categories.gapClearTillAddresses: Harder to maintain when dates, one-off costs and balances change.
categories.fairnessRule: Do not imply everybody finds mental arithmetic difficult.

categories.gapClearTillAddresses: ClearTill saves an updateable position and can carry recurring costs forward with reminders.
categories.fairnessRule: Acknowledge that a well-maintained spreadsheet can perform the arithmetic.

categories.alternative: Budgeting tools connected through Open Banking
categories.strength: Can automate transaction collection and categorisation.
categories.gapClearTillAddresses: ClearTill offers a focused manual route without a bank connection.
categories.fairnessRule: Do not claim Open Banking is inherently unsafe or that connected tools give away credentials.

categories.strength: Useful for broader spending plans and longer-term habits.
categories.gapClearTillAddresses: ClearTill focuses narrowly on the forward position to the next income date.
